description: This file defines data models for OpenAPI components using Pydantic, including schemas, responses, parameters, security schemes, and the main OpenAPI object.

classes.name: Schema
classes.description: Represents a JSON Schema object with support for JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 features.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Models an OpenAPI response object, including description, headers, content, and links.

classes.name: Parameter
classes.description: Defines an OpenAPI parameter with details like name, location, schema, and examples.

classes.name: Operation
classes.description: Represents an API operation with tags, responses, parameters, and other metadata.

classes.name: PathItem
classes.description: Models an OpenAPI path item with HTTP methods and associated operations.

classes.name: SecurityScheme
classes.description: Union type for different security schemes like API key, HTTP, OAuth2, and OpenID Connect.

classes.name: Components
classes.description: Contains reusable components such as schemas, responses, parameters, and security schemes.

classes.name: Tag
classes.description: Represents a tag for API documentation grouping.

classes.name: OpenAPI
classes.description: Main class representing the root OpenAPI document with info, paths, components, and metadata.

methods.name: Schema.model_rebuild
methods.description: Rebuilds the Pydantic model for Schema class to support forward references.

methods.name: Operation.model_rebuild
methods.description: Rebuilds the Pydantic model for Operation class to support forward references.

methods.name: Encoding.model_rebuild
methods.description: Rebuilds the Pydantic model for Encoding class to support forward references.
